mihoyo.name: 恶名·死路屠夫
fieldBuffTexts: 属性异常对首领敌人造成的伤害提升50%；恶名·死路屠夫处于[以太强化]状态时，承受的伤害降低15%，代理人对其造成的失衡值降低30%；代理人对恶名·死路屠夫触发[紊乱]后，使其立即退出[以太强化]状态。
performanceTexts: 成功触发[极限闪避]时，可获得200操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.name: Notorious: Dead End Butcher
buhflipexplode.descText: DMG dealt to boss enemies by Attribute Anomaly is increased by 50%. Triggering Disorder on Notorious: Dead End Butcher immediately forces it to exit the Ether Enhanced state.
buhflipexplode.perfText: Successfully triggering Perfect Dodge grants 200 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

mihoyo.name: 自律强袭单位·「提丰·破坏者型」
fieldBuffTexts: 代理人发动[招架支援]命中首领敌人时，将对其施加1层[难敌四手]，[招架支援]累计命中3次时，将触发部位破坏，并额外施加3层[难敌四手]，每层[难敌四手]会使代理人对首领敌人造成的失衡值提升15%，在失衡状态下[连携技]和[终结技]对其造成的伤害提升10%；敌人充电蓄能时，将修复受损部位井重置部位破坏进度；敌人从失衡状态恢复时，[难敌四手]层数将会被重置。

成功造成部位破坏时，可获得600操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.descText: Agents inflict Overwhelmed when landing a Defensive Assist hit against a Boss enemy, and 3 stacks of Overwhelmed when accumulating 3 Defensive Assist hits and triggering IMPAIRED!!. Each stack of Overwhelmed increases Daze by 15%, and Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG taken while Stunned by 10%. The enemy will fix the impaired parts and reset the impairment level while charging, and will reset its Overwhelmed stacks after recovering from Stun.

Successfully triggering a Perfect Assist grants 200 Performance Points.
Successfully causing IMPAIRED!! grants 600 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

mihoyo.name: 驰援

buhflipexplode.name: Rapid Aid

The Agent's Energy Generation Rate increases by 25%, and the DMG dealt by Quick Assist increases by 50%.
Each use of Quick Assist increases all squad members' ATK by 10% for 20s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

mihoyo.name: 锐进

buhflipexplode.name: Swift Advance
buhflipexplode.effectText:
DMG dealt by Agent Aftershocks and Chain Attacks is increased by 30%.

mihoyo.name: 蓄变
effectTexts: 代理人的以太属性异常积蓄效率和物理属性异常积蓄效率将提升25%，异常精通提升60点。
触发属性异常时，敌人的防御力降低10%，且承受的属性异常伤害提升30%，持续20秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。

buhflipexplode.name: Transformation Charge

mihoyo.name: 牲鬼·布林格
fieldBuffTexts: 对首领敌人施加属性异常或[紊乱]效果时，全队获得1层[心无旁骛]，最多叠加6层，每层[心无旁骛]会使代理人的攻击力提升8%；拥有至少3层[心无旁骛]后，队伍中任意代理人对敌人施加属性异常效果时，该效果的持续时间提升5秒；牲鬼·布林格召唤「牲祭之刃」发动攻击时，全队[心无旁骛]层数将会被重置。
performanceTexts: 成功打断吟唱时，可获得2000操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.name: Sacrifice: Bringer

When Sacrifice: Bringer attacks with his Sacrificial Knife, all squad members' Laser Focus stacks will be reset.
buhflipexplode.perfText: Successfully interrupting a chant grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

mihoyo.name: 未知复合侵蚀体

performanceTexts: 成功造成部位破坏时，可获得800操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.perfText: Successfully inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies grants 150 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

mihoyo.name: 游刃
effectTexts: 代理人的属性异常积蓄效率提升25%，异常精通提升40点。
对敌人施加属性异常效果时，代理人额外获得500点喧响值，攻击力提升30%，持续15秒，喧响值获得效果15秒内最多触发一次。

buhflipexplode.name: Graceful Mastery
buhflipexplode.effectText:
Increases Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate by 25% and Anomaly Proficiency by 40.
When an enemy suffers an Attribute Anomaly, Agents recover 500 additional Decibels and ATK increases by 30% for 15s. The Decibel recovery effect can trigger once every 15s.

mihoyo.name: 速决
effectTexts: 代理人的攻击力提升20%，喧响值获取效率提升20%；发动[终结技]时，代理人的攻击力额外提升15%，持续15秒。
[终结技]造成的伤害提升40%，造成的失衡值提升20%，累积的属性异常积蓄值提升20%。

buhflipexplode.name: Swift Resolution
buhflipexplode.effectText: Agent ATK increases by 20%, Decibel Generation Rate increases by 20%. Upon launching an Ultimate, Agent ATK increases by an additional 15% for 15s. Ultimate DMG increases by 40%, Daze dealt increases by 20%, and Anomaly Buildup increases by 20%.

mihoyo.name: 倾覆
effectTexts: 代理人造成的失衡值提升25%，[连携技]造成的伤害提升80%。
发动[连携技]时，代理人回复20点能量，造成的伤害提升50%，持续20秒。

buhflipexplode.name: Overthrow
buhflipexplode.effectText:
Increases Agent Daze by 25% and Chain Attack DMG by 80%.
When a Chain Attack is triggered, the Agent recovers 20 Energy, and DMG increases by 50% for 20s.

mihoyo.name: 牲鬼·布林格
fieldBuffTexts: 对首领敌人施加属性异常或[紊乱]效果时，全队获得1层[心无旁骛]，最多叠加6层，每层[心无旁骛]会使代理人的暴击率提升5%；拥有至少3层[心无旁骛]后，队伍中任意代理人对敌人施加属性异常效果时，该效果的持续时间提升5秒；牲鬼·布林格召唤「牲祭之刃」发动攻击时，全队[心无旁骛]层数将会被重置。
performanceTexts: 成功打断吟唱时，可获得2000操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.name: Sacrifice: Bringer
buhflipexplode.descText: When inflicting an Attribute Anomaly or Disorder on a boss enemy, all squad members gain Laser Focus, which stacks up to 6 times. Each stack of Laser Focus increases the agent's CRIT Rate by 5%. When having at least 3 stacks of Laser Focus, inflicting an Attribute Anomaly will increase its duration by 5s. When Sacrifice: Bringer attacks with his Sacrificial Knife, all squad members' Laser Focus stacks will be reset.
buhflipexplode.perfText: Successfully interrupting a chant grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

mihoyo.name: 自律强袭单位·「提丰·破坏者型」
fieldBuffTexts: 代理人发动[招架支援]命中首领敌人时，将对其施加1层[难敌四手]，[招架支援]累计命中3次时，将触发部位破坏，并额外施加3层[难敌四手]，每层[难敌四手]会使代理人对首领敌人造成的失衡值提升15%，在失衡状态下[连携技]和[终结技]对其造成的伤害提升10%；敌人充电蓄能时，将修复受损部位井重置部位破坏进度；敌人从失衡状态恢复时，[难敌四手]层数将会被重置。
performanceTexts: 成功造成部位破坏时，可获得600操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.name: Typhon Destroyer
buhflipexplode.descText: Agents inflict Overwhelmed when landing a Defensive Assist hit against a Boss enemy, and 3 stacks of Overwhelmed when accumulating 3 Defensive Assist hits and triggering IMPAIRED!!. Each stack of Overwhelmed increases Daze by 15%, and Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG taken while Stunned by 10%. The enemy will fix the impaired parts and reset the impairment level while charging, and will reset its Overwhelmed stacks after recovering from Stun.
buhflipexplode.perfText: Successfully impairing an enemy grants 600 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

mihoyo.name: 死路屠夫
fieldBuffTexts: 未处于失衡状态下时，首领敌人每6秒获得1层[孤注一掷]，最多叠加3层，每层[孤注一掷]会使首领敌人造成的伤害提升10%；代理人攻击命中敌人时，目标每拥有1层[孤注一掷]，代理人的暴击伤害提升25%；敌人从失衡状态恢复时，[孤注一掷]层数将会被重置。
performanceTexts: 成功触发[极限闪避]时，可获得150操作得分，最多获得5000操作得分。

buhflipexplode.name: Dead End Butcher
buhflipexplode.descText: When not in a Stunned state, Boss enemies gain 1 stack of All or Nothing every 6s, stacking up to 3 stacks. When an Agent's attack hits an enemy, the Agent's CRIT DMG increases by 25% for each stack of All or Nothing the target has. All or Nothing stacks will be reset when the enemy recovers from being Stunned.
buhflipexplode.perfText: Successfully triggering Perfect Dodge grants 150 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.
